publications.explanation: Prolactin is the intended answer for milk production: it stimulates the milk-producing cells of the mammary glands. Distinguish production from release. Oxytocin also acts on the breast, causing the muscular contractions that move milk into the ducts during the let-down reflex. Thus, the broad wording “function of mammary glands” should not be read as saying that oxytocin has no role. Remember the distinction: prolactin helps make milk; oxytocin helps eject it. [U.S. Office on Women’s Health: making breastmilk](https://womenshealth.gov/breastfeeding/learning-breastfeed/making-breastmilk).

publications.explanation: D is highest in the ordering described. Translate each comparison into a relation, with “>” meaning higher in the report: B > A, D > C, C > B and A > E. Joining them gives D > C > B > A > E. Therefore D is above every other child, including C, even though C is not among the answer choices. Compare the relationships given in the question rather than assuming that the letters themselves indicate rank.

publications.explanation: “Abridged” means shortened, usually by editing out some material while retaining the main content. An abridged version of a classic is therefore a shorter edition than the original, fitting the comparison in the sentence. “Abandoned” means left or given up; “abated” describes something becoming less intense; and “classical” describes a style or tradition. Those words do not identify a shortened edition. The clue is the contrast between a version and the original text.
